source.title: Some open problems in optimal digraphs

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 889960. Local network fetching with curl failed with DNS resolution errors for zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org, and the web page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record for https://zbmath.org/889960.

Identifier-specific and exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier 889960, the exact title from local corpus metadata, and exact-title web searches. The reachable SAS journal issue table of contents confirmed the same work as Miller, M.: Some open problems in optimal digraphs, Tatra Mountains Mathematical Publications, Volume 9, 1996, No. 3, starting on page 89.

Bounded recovery inspected exact-title results and candidate pages for the SAS issue, Tatra Mountains Mathematical Publications site, and later citing surveys. The SAS page exposed only a table of contents, not the article body; Tatra article/full-text endpoints were not retrievable through the available page reader; later survey and thesis candidates cited the work but were different sources and could not be used as the technical source. Failure mode: metadata_only plus network_or_dns_failure/missing_or_invalid_artifact for full-text endpoints.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Per source adequacy and no-new-facts gates, no questions were extracted from resolver metadata, a table of contents, search snippets, or citing papers.
Saved the JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-889960.json and outputs/latest.json.
